rows.en: Brera, my drink.
rows.notes: Grace to Brera; shared by ext_oth_903/904, both player genders.

rows.en: Yes, Grace-sama.
What's on my schedule after this?

Yes.
At 14:00, a meeting with the record company.
At 14:30, picking up Sheryl-sama.

At 14:45, a meeting about a TV program.
At 15:00, a magazine interview.
...............

...............
...That is the schedule.
I see... Thank you.

(Just what's going on between
Grace-san and Brera-san...?)
(Huh... Isn't that...?)

Oh, \p.
What are you doing here?

I was just wandering around.
What about you, Ozma-san?

M-me?
I'm, uh... here for that thing...
rows.notes: 'Ore wa da na, are da': deliberately vague 'that thing'.

rows.en: That thing, huh.
Yeah, that thing...

\p,
you're free right now, aren't you?

Huh?
Me?
Sure, I'm free.
rows.notes: Choice and also the spoken line after it.

rows.en: I just remembered something I have to do!!
Sorry, but I need you to come with me...
...and help me pick out a present for Ranka...
Oh, sure. Roger that.
(Glad it wasn't anything weird.)

You really helped me out,
\p.
Did I? I'm honored I could be of use.
You show real promise, you know that?
I-I don't think that's really true...
...Keep on being a good friend to Ranka, okay?
Yes, absolutely!
But don't push your luck... Got it?
rows.notes: 'Choushi ni wa noru na yo': don't get cocky / get ideas.

rows.en: Well then, get home safe.
Bye~

(Ozma-san's scary, but he's a good big brother
who really cares about Ranka.)
I-I just remembered something I have to do!!

Don't you lie to me!
You damn idiot!!
rows.notes: Bakayarou at full strength; shared by both genders.

rows.en:
Forget it!
Just go! Go wherever you want!!
I-I'b sooorry...!!
rows.notes: Japanese is a tearful, slurred 'sumimasen'; kept the slur.

rows.en: (Ozma-san is way too scary!!)

I was doing some window shopping.
What about you, Ozma-san?

Huh?
Me?
(Glad it wasn't anything weird~)

(Ozma-san's scary, but he's a good big brother
who really cares about Ranka-chan.)

(Oh right, today's the day of S.M.S.
special training...)

\p.
So you finally showed up...
Captain Ozma! Thanks for having me!
rows.notes: 'Otsukaresama desu' as a greeting to a superior; no exact English. Shared by both genders.

rows.en: Looks like you're fired up.
Then let's get started.

...Huh?
Where are Alto and the others?
Today it's a special program just for you.
Um, my stomach hurts. Can I leave early?
You damn idiot!!!!!!

Today's training is to whip that slack
attitude of yours back into shape!!
You got that?!!
Y-yiiikes!!

Even I'm not a demon.
I'll let you choose your own training menu.
(I've got nothing but a bad feeling about this~)
1. 50 km march wearing EX-Gear
rows.notes: Spoken by Ozma and also a choice.

rows.en:
2. 100 sets of 100 push-ups, sit-ups
and back extensions
rows.notes: Spoken by Ozma and also a choice.

rows.en: 3. 50-hour Valkyrie simulator endurance test
rows.notes: Spoken by Ozma and also a choice.

rows.en: Now, pick whichever one you like.

Th-that's impossible!
Any of those would kill me for sure!

You can't do it 'cause you keep saying you can't!
If you put your mind to it, you can do any of 'em!!
Now, choose!
Number 1, then...

The march, huh...
Complete it, and you'll become a true warrior.
(More like a war casualty...)
rows.notes: Pun on senshi (warrior) / senshi (killed in action).

rows.en:
Then let's go!
Follow me!!
Huh, you're coming too, Captain Ozma?

Of course I am!
As if I'd send a subordinate out alone!
rows.notes: Shared by both genders: neutral 'a subordinate'.

rows.en: (...What's gonna happen to me...)
Tch, I forgot to get the EX-Gear overhauled...
Phew.

Clean the garage instead!
Got it?!
(Th-that was a close one...)
Number 2, then...

Basic training, huh. Your weakness is that
you lean on cheap tricks. Relearn the basics
and turn them into an even bigger leap!!
rows.notes: Generic basic training (not the class name).

rows.en: Then let's go!
Huh, you're doing it too, Captain Ozma?
Of course!

uncertain: c02636: 'Otsukaresama desu' (greeting to a superior on arrival) rendered 'Thanks for having me!'.
